analysis: The change to docs/architecture/inference.md is documentation-only. It bumps the 'Last updated' date on line 3 and appends one troubleshooting table row at head line 3552 about a provider crash loop on a pre-release macOS 27.2 build. The supplied units are base-side excerpts (lines 1626-2425) of unchanged surrounding text, so they contain no changed lines. I read them against the threat model and found no new code behavior, API, wire format, key handling or configuration default. The excerpts describe calibration warmup, chunk batching, SSD prefix-cache staging, deadline admission, MTP upgrades and sampling defaults. They are descriptive of existing behavior and match T-041 (prefix cache: 30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup tags, cacheSalt scoping) and T-008/T-010 (fail-closed encryption, cancellation) without altering any control. The only visible new content is the troubleshooting row, which is truncated in the patch excerpt. Its text on SDK 27.2 and Date comparisons is operational guidance and not a security claim. I cannot see the full row. Residual uncertainty is low: any claim in it about crash-loop mitigation, such as watchdog or rollback behavior under T-043, is outside the supplied evidence. This is a documentation row, not a code change, so no integration questions are material.
